overview: The Board of Health met to review local property inspection updates, receive public health reports on vaccine clinics and mobile care, adjudicate tobacco compliance violations, and hear a BSL-2 permit presentation from Tufts University.

items.title: Acceptance of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: Property Violations Follow-Up
items.summary: Heard updates on property violations, noting that 40th Century Street corrected all violations and 8 Main Street made substantial progress on pest control issues.

items.title: Communicable Disease Report, Care Van, and Vaccine Clinics Update
items.summary: Heard updates on the transition to quarterly communicable disease reports, the upcoming September 29 community care van visit, and the launch of the city's seasonal flu and COVID-19 vaccine clinics.

items.title: Tobacco Compliance Hearings
items.summary: Approved a motion to permit non-consecutive seven-day suspensions alongside the mandated $2,000 fines for McSheffrey's Mobile and NK Convenience following second-offense tobacco violations.

items.title: Tufts University Bioinnovation Lab Presentation
items.summary: Received a presentation from Tufts University and BioLabs detailing a BSL-2 permit application for a food and materials R&D incubator at 200 Boston Avenue.
